verdict.rationale: Unleash is a feature-flag SaaS/platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. Unleash documents a first-party MCP server that lets LLM-powered coding assistants create and manage feature flags and debug flag evaluation, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: detailed setup/transport/auth documentation in the pack, a full tool list, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.
Check why a user gets or doesn't get a flag.
